short: Speech-task ECoG cursor control (M04) and 1-mm microgrid control (M05) are standard: a closed-loop speech-cortex BCI preceded it, imagined control is vowel-vs-rest, and n=1 microgrid.
position: The paper [@leuthardt2011using] changes the control action (M04) and the sensor (M05); both are standard. Closed-loop control from speech cortex preceded it [@guenther2009], and earlier same-group ECoG cursor tasks included single-word articulation [@leuthardt2004brain; @schalk2008two]. Its addition is vowel-specific screened features and imagined vowel versus rest as an ECoG control task, shown in 4 patients with one pairing each. The 1-bit online result beats a noise-derived 46.2% chance, but condition is confounded with patient, imagined trials are unmonitored, and the text disagrees with Table 2 on final accuracies. Today attempted-speech BCIs reach 99.6% on 50 words on day one [@card2024].
